# Calorie
> A private, local-first food, water, and weight journal with transparent timing guidance. Optional Google or Apple sign-in can add private Cloudflare sync.

## When to use this
- Best fit: tracking food, water, medication, and weight on iPhone/iPad with local-first privacy
- Best fit: deterministic, transparent calorie and nutrient guidance without a subscription
- Not a fit: social food logging, restaurant scanning, or web-based diet tracking
- Not a fit: medical nutrition therapy or replacing a registered dietitian

## CLI

```bash
# Fetch the agent catalog
curl -s https://calorie.significanthobbies.com/api/ai | jq .

# Get the OpenAPI spec
curl -s https://calorie.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json | jq .

# Fetch the homepage as markdown
curl -s -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://calorie.significanthobbies.com/
```

## Product boundaries
- No social feed
- Not medical advice
- Default data is local-first; optional private cloud sync
- No App Store listing yet
